core_meaning.primary_meaning: Meshaal is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Torch, flame, light”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Meshaal corresponds to the Arabic form مشعل (Arabic root ش ع ل (sh-ʿ-l); مِشْعَل (Mishʿal)). Its core sense is torch, flame, light. Meshaal is Arabic مِشْعَل (Mishʿal) 'torch, flame, light', from the root ش ع ل (sh-ʿ-l). The source gloss 'Guide, Aide, Companion' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mishaal and mashal.
